one_liner: Tiny, broke, loud Kansai girl who races as the 'White Lightning' to support her many little siblings.
personality: A fast-talking Naniwa girl who plays the straight man (tsukkomi) to everyone else's nonsense and laughs at her own jokes. She grew up poor and is fiercely frugal: perks up at sales, frets about the school's electricity bill and still picks up ginkgo nuts. Underneath the bluster she is a doting big sister ('Tama-neene') who runs to repay her family, and she is touchy about being small. Warm and generous with her time, she offers to carry the trainer's burdens with them.

story_arc.summary: A tiny girl from a poor Osaka family who came to Tracen to win, make a name and send money home. Her career runs through the classic and senior races (Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikka Sho, then Hanshin Daishoten, Tenno Sho Spring/Autumn, Takarazuka, Japan Cup, Arima); event titles trace a climb 'from rock bottom' (ドン底から上を) to becoming the 'White Lightning', a 'father to child' Takarazuka and a Japan Cup duel 'with you forever' (オマエと永遠に) that fans read as her rivalry with Oguri Cap. Her late-career theme is carrying everyone's hopes; her alternate outfit casts her as a shrine 'shinme' (sacred horse).
